newsitem.title: USA: Mont. Colstrip 2 back on line, but 1 and 3 down.
newsitem.headline: Mont. Colstrip 2 back on line, but 1 and 3 down.

text.p: The 330 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the Colstrip coal-fired power plant near Billings, Mont., went back on line as expected, but the plant's 700 MW unit 3 and 330 MW unit 1 were off line, a Montana Power Co spokesman said Friday.
Unit 3 had returned to service Thursday after being shut early this week for unplanned repairs, but was taken back down because of a tube leak, he said.
Unit 3 is expected to restart Saturday evening.
The plant's unit 1 was also shut for unplanned work which is expected to be finished sometime next week, the spokesman said.
Montana Power, operator of the Colstrip plant, is also responsible for the sale of 30 percent of unit 4's power ouptut under long-term contracts.

Equity owners include Puget Sound Power and Light Co, Washington Water Power Co, Portland General Electric Co, Pacific Power and Light, and a consortium of GE Credit, Shell Oil Co and a lease-back firm.
